unit: JPY per construction worker-day (labour cost input, national all-trades weighted average of the public-works design labour rate)

baseline.source: 公共工事設計労務単価 令和8年3月適用 全国全職種加重平均値 25,834円, https://www.mlit.go.jp/report/press/content/001981942.pdf (2026-02-17)

notes: baseline: a LABOUR INPUT rate, not a price of a building service; excludes employer-borne overhead per the same source. delta vs this = labour-cost reduction per equivalent worker-day. with_bot must come from costs of work this repo's actor actually processed (n_events >= 30); never simulated.
